specific_objectives: 6.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to describe aircraft stability in all the three axis.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review video clips; Instructor supervises note-taking on stability axes; Safety: Ensure no loose items during video playback.
intro_questions: What are the three axes of an aircraft?
Define static stability in your own words.
Why is stability important for flight safety?

development.content:
Longitudinal stability definition
Pitching moment characteristics
Center of gravity effects
Horizontal stabilizer function

Lateral stability definition
Rolling moment characteristics
Dihedral angle effect
Wing sweep influence

Directional stability definition
Yawing moment characteristics
Vertical stabilizer function
Rudder control authority

summary_questions: Explain how the horizontal stabilizer contributes to longitudinal stability.
Describe the role of the dihedral angle in lateral stability.
How does the vertical stabilizer affect directional stability?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the concepts of aircraft stability discussed in this lesson will assist in understanding low-speed wind tunnel testing in LP 32.

pft_rows.syllabus: Low speed wind tunnel and wind tunnel balances. Demonstration on pressure plotting experiments
